questions.question: The budget for a construction project is allocated to land acquisition, building materials, and labor in the ratio 5 : 3 : 2. During the project, the cost of land acquisition rose by 5%, building materials rose by 10%, and labor fell by 20%. What is the percent change (increase or decrease) in the total project cost?
questions.questionHtml: The budget for a construction project is allocated to land acquisition, building materials, and labor in the ratio 5 : 3 : 2. During the project, the cost of land acquisition rose by 5%, building materials rose by 10%, and labor fell by 20%. What is the percent change (increase or decrease) in the total project cost?
questions.solution:
⇒ Take ratio as 500 : 300 : 200

⇒ Initial total = 500 + 300 + 200 = 1000

⇒ New Land = 500 × 105 ÷ 100 = 525

⇒ New Materials = 300 × 110 ÷ 100 = 330

⇒ New Labor = 200 × 80 ÷ 100 = 160

⇒ New total = 525 + 330 + 160 = 1015

⇒ Increase = 1015 − 1000 = 15

⇒ Percent change = 15 ÷ 1000 × 100 = 1.5%

Find the ratio of the quantity of premium flour to standard flour in the original order.

Due to an ordering error, the quantities of the two types of flour were interchanged. This decreased the total cost by 25%. <svg width="500" height="320" viewBox="0 0 500 320" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

</svg>

questions.question: A vendor sold 15 toys for ₹3000 and gained a profit of 25%. How many toys should he sell for ₹2816 to make a profit of 10%?
questions.questionHtml: A vendor sold 15 toys for ₹3000 and gained a profit of 25%. How many toys should he sell for ₹2816 to make a profit of 10%?
questions.solution:
<svg width="550" height="260" viewBox="0 0 550 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

    <marker id="arrO" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#cc5500"/></marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- ZONE 1: PROFIT & LOSS MECHANISM -->
  <!-- Case 1: SP1 and 15 Toys -->
  <rect x="40" y="40" width="300" height="30" fill="#ddeeff" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="160" y="60" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#2255cc">SP₁ = ₹3000</text>
  
  <rect x="340" y="40" width="75" height="30" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="345" y="60" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">+25% Profit</text>
  
  <!-- Toy Icons Case 1 -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 15)">
    <circle cx="10" cy="5" r="5" fill="#555555"/>
    <path d="M5,10 L15,10 L18,20 L2,20 Z" fill="#555555"/>
    <text x="25" y="18" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">x 15 Toys</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Case 2: SP2 and X Toys -->
  <rect x="40" y="100" width="281" height="30" fill="#fff0cc" stroke="#cc5500" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="150" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500">SP₂ = ₹2816</text>
  
  <rect x="321" y="100" width="30" height="30" fill="#ccffcc" stroke="#007700" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="355" y="120" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#007700">+10% Profit</text>
  
  <!-- Toy Icons Case 2 -->
  <g transform="translate(40, 75)">
    <circle cx="10" cy="5" r="5" fill="#555555"/>
    <path d="M5,10 L15,10 L18,20 L2,20 Z" fill="#555555"/>
    <text x="25" y="18" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">x "n" Toys</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Proportionality Link -->
  <path d="M420,55 Q460,85 420,115" fill="none" stroke="#888888" stroke-dasharray="5,3" marker-end="url(#arrO)"/>
  <text x="440" y="90" font-family="Arial" font-size="12" fill="#555555">Ratio Constant</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: CALCULATION -->
  <text x="40" y="165" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ ₹3000 ÷ (15 × 125%) = ₹2816 ÷ (n × 110%)</text>
  <text x="40" y="190" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ 1.6 = 25.6 ÷ n ⇒ n = 25.6 ÷ 1.6</text>
  
  <text x="40" y="225" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = 16 toys</text>
</svg>

<svg width="520" height="280" viewBox="0 0 520 280" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

  <!-- Tea Sack 2 -->
  <path d="M420,40 Q420,20 440,20 Q460,20 460,40 L465,100 Q465,110 440,110 Q415,110 415,100 Z" fill="#ede7f6" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="415" y="15" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#6a1b9a">CP2: ₹250</text>

  <path d="M220,100 L300,100 Q300,150 260,150 Q220,150 220,100 Z" fill="#f0f0f0" stroke="#555555" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="230" y="125" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">Mix CP: ₹225</text>

  <path d="M115,80 Q160,80 210,110" fill="none" stroke="#2255cc" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  <path d="M405,80 Q360,80 310,110" fill="none" stroke="#6a1b9a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arr)"/>
  
  <!-- Result Path -->
  <path d="M260,155 L260,180" fill="none" stroke="#cc0000" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#arrO)" stroke-dasharray="4,2"/>
  <text x="270" y="175" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc0000">SP: ₹175</text>

  <!-- ZONE 2: SOLUTION -->
  <text x="30" y="210" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ CP1 = 150 × (100/75) = ₹200 | CP2 = 200 × (100/80) = ₹250</text>
  <text x="30" y="232" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Avg. CP = (200 + 250) ÷ 2 = ₹225 | SP = ₹175</text>
  <text x="30" y="254" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#222222">⇒ Loss% = (225 − 175) ÷ 225 × 100 = 22.22%</text>

  <text x="30" y="275" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#000000">∴ Answer = Loss of 22.22%</text>
</svg>

questions.question: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 15 days. C and A together can do it in 20 days. In how many days can A alone complete the job?
questions.questionHtml: A and B together can complete a work in 12 days. B and C together can complete the same work in 15 days. C and A together can do it in 20 days. In how many days can A alone complete the job?
questions.solution:
⇒ LCM of 12, 15, and 20 = 60 units

⇒ (A + B) 1 day work = 60 ÷ 12 = 5 units

⇒ (B + C) 1 day work = 60 ÷ 15 = 4 units

⇒ (C + A) 1 day work = 60 ÷ 20 = 3 units

⇒ (A + B) + (B + C) + (C + A) = 5 + 4 + 3 = 12 units

⇒ 2(A + B + C) = 12 units ⇒ A + B + C = 12 ÷ 2 = 6 units

⇒ A = (A + B + C) − (B + C) = 6 − 4 = 2 units/day

⇒ Days taken by A alone = 60 ÷ 2 = 30 days

questions.question: A car covers 40% of a certain distance at a pace of 20 km/h and the remaining distance at a pace of 30 km/h. What is the average speed of the car for the entire journey?
questions.questionHtml: A car covers 40% of a certain distance at a pace of 20 km/h and the remaining distance at a pace of 30 km/h. What is the average speed of the car for the entire journey?
questions.solution:
Let total distance = 100 km.

Distance1 = 40 km, Distance2 = 60 km.

Time1 = 40 ÷ 20 = 2 hours, Time2 = 60 ÷ 30 = 2 hours.

Total time = 2 + 2 = 4 hours.

Average speed = 100 ÷ 4 = 25 km/h.

questions.question: What is the radian measure of 150°?
questions.questionHtml: What is the radian measure of 150°?
questions.solution:
Angle in degrees = 150º

π radians = 180º

Radian = 150 × (π ÷ 180) ⇒ 150π ÷ 180 ⇒ 5π ÷ 6

questions.question: What is the area of a sector with a central angle of 120° and radius 8 cm?
questions.questionHtml: What is the area of a sector with a central angle of 120° and radius 8 cm?
questions.solution:
Central angle = 120º, Radius = 8 cm

Area of sector = (120 ÷ 360) × π × 82

⇒ Area of sector = (1 ÷ 3) × π × 64

⇒ Area of sector = (64π ÷ 3) cm2

sin(90º − x) = cos x

cos x = cos(2x)

questions.question: Given, A and B are complementary angles, and sinA = \(\frac{3}{5}\) , what is tanB?
questions.questionHtml: Given, A and B are complementary angles, and sinA = \(\frac{3}{5}\), what is tanB?
questions.solution:
A + B = 90º, then B = 90º − A.

sin A = 3 ÷ 5 ⇒ Opposite = 3, Hypotenuse = 5 ⇒ Adjacent = √(52 − 32) = √(25 − 9) = √16 = 4.

tan B = tan(90º − A) = cot A ⇒ cot A = Adjacent ÷ Opposite = 4 ÷ 3 ⇒ tan B = 4 ÷ 3.

questions.question: If \(sin²A – cos²A = \frac{1}{4}\) , find the value of cos²A.
questions.questionHtml: If \(sin²A – cos²A = \frac{1}{4}\), find the value of cos²A.
questions.solution:
sin2A + cos2A = 1

⇒ sin2A = 1 − cos2A

⇒ (1 − cos2A) − cos2A = 1/4

⇒ 1 − 2cos2A = 1/4

⇒ 3/4 = 2cos2A

⇒ cos2A = 3/8
